image_description: A lively outdoor scene featuring a traditional May Day celebration. A tall, decorated pole (maypole) stands in the center, adorned with long, colorful ribbons extending to the ground. Numerous children and adults are holding these ribbons, dancing or preparing to dance around the pole on a grassy field. The background includes trees and spectators.
